newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani vegoil prices seen steady in near term.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani vegoil prices seen steady in near term.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil prices are expected to remain unchanged in the next week owing to good stock position in the local market, dealers said on Saturday.

"We expect a slight rise in vegoil rates abroad, but prices in the local market will remain stable owing to the good stock position," dealer Saulat Khan said. "The arrival of cottonseed is also likely to start by the end of this month, which will hold the local prices steady."
Dealers said last week that vegoil prices slid slightly in the local market as supply remained good.
Vegoil stocks rose to 160,000 tonnes last week from 156,000 tonnes in the previous week on arrival of fresh supplies.
Dealers said RBD palm oil and palm olein stocks remained steady at 125,000 tonnes as in the last week. Soyoil and sunflower oil stocks rose to 27,000 tonnes from 20,000.
The state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan (GCP) has a stock of 8,000 tonnes of palm oil and palm olien stocks compared to 11,000 tonnes last week.
The GCP has arranged the import of 9,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil by September 7 and another 9,000 tonnes by October 10.

One ship is now discharging 20,500 tonnes of palmoil at the Port Qasim, near Karachi, one dealer said. "Vessels with a total of 24,900 tonnes of vegoil for Pakistan are standing at the outer anchorage."
